## Welcome: Build your daily triage assistant

You will create a supervised daily workflow that summarizes new issues and recommends labels. You remain responsible for every repository change.

Start on **Home**, open **My Work**, and find this repository. Open **Exercise: Build your daily triage assistant**, then visit **Automations** to see where the recurring workflow will appear.

During the exercise, Work IQ acts as a Microsoft 365 skill and can expose its tools to an agent through an MCP server. You will use only a source type and sanitized planning signal, never raw workplace content.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Use only synthetic repository content or a sanitized planning signal. Never post workplace content or credentials.
